Small business bookkeeping is still broken | Ledger Notes

Small business bookkeeping is still broken

Every quarter I rebuild the same report by hand because the export only covers the account I happen to have open.

I run three bank accounts and the totals never match what the bank tells me, so I spend a whole weekend chasing a two hundred dollar difference that was never real.

The support answer is always "open a ticket and attach a screenshot", which does not help when the screenshot looks the same on every page.

Is there a way to see all three accounts in one place without opening three separate tabs every morning?

It would be nice if the monthly report could be scheduled so it lands in my inbox on the first of the month.

Most of these tools are the same. Every small business tool is worse than the last one and nothing here solves my problem.
input.span: Is there a way to see all three accounts in one place without opening three separate tabs every morning?
